name: Route Map + One Promise
description: A 16:9 symbolic route cover with one wayfinding anchor and a complete exact episode-title promise rendered directly in a dominant title-safe band.
composition_guidance: Use one symbolic route or wayfinding anchor that clearly connects a start to an end without claiming factual navigation. Reserve an uncluttered upper title-safe band for the complete exact episode title rendered directly by the selected image model. The route remains symbolic: the active Visual Style remains the final authority for medium, palette, texture, lighting, and rendering technique.
composition_rules: Use one symbolic route or wayfinding anchor between a clear start and end.
Reserve the upper third as an uncluttered title-safe band for the complete exact episode title.
Keep route markers symbolic rather than geographically or commercially factual.
Use the title band and route anchor as one immediate reading path without competing destinations.
required_elements: One route or wayfinding anchor with a clear start and end
One qualified promise expressed as the complete exact episode title
avoid_elements: Factual navigation, distances, boundaries, directions, or map accuracy claims
Business endorsements, listings, logos, booking details, or hours
Safety guarantees, local availability claims, or extra text
Watermarks, copied assets, copied trade dress, or post-render typography compositing
Misspelled, clipped, placeholder, or illegible title text
headline_guidance: Render the complete exact episode title directly in the upper title-safe band. Do not paraphrase, abbreviate, add extra text, or use post-render typography compositing. Use one, two, or three balanced lines only as required to preserve the exact title and small-screen readability.
visual_style_guidance: The recipe controls only the symbolic route anchor, bounded promise, and upper title-safe band. It does not create a factual map or constrain the active Visual Style's medium, palette, texture, lighting, or rendering details.
